# Withdrawn ordinary Basis-function proposal

These four complete informed first projects and eight actual finite/selected
checks precede production changes. The maintainer withdrew the proposed
ordinary `basis fn` reuse unit because its name conflicts with `basis`.
[Withdrawal](withdrawal.json) records that direct human instruction and the
absence of production changes at withdrawal. The later human-selected
[classical-function study](../classical-runtime-v030/README.md) is separate;
these original sources, context, predictions and results remain unchanged.

All eight recorded checks reject ordinary calls to Basis declarations. The
finite diagnostic is `type_mismatch`; the selected diagnostic is `type`.
They retain the actual explanation that Basis/Meaning declarations are not
ordinary runtime callees. In particular, the quantum-argument source stops
at that callee-category rule: its observation does not establish the later
`Q<Bit>` versus ordinary `Bit` argument condition. There are no AFTER calls
or source repairs in this withdrawn packet.
